packet.headline_seed: Trump sending Witkoff and Kushner to Pakistan to resume talks on Iran war
packet.description_seed: White House says its Middle East envoys will meet Tehran’s foreign minister in Islamabad Middle East crisis – live updates Donald Trump is sending his Middle East envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner to Pakistan to resume negotiations to end the war with Iran, which has lasted nearly eight weeks. The White House spokesperson Karoline Leavitt confirmed the travel on Friday, saying that Witkoff and Kushner, Trump’s son-in-law, would meet Iran’s foreign minister, Abbas Araghchi, in Islamabad. She said: “We’re hopeful that it will be a productive conversation and hopefully move the ball forward to a deal.” Continue reading...
